title: Temporary Injunction for Protection Against Repeat Violence
plain_language_summary: This is a court order, not a form a person fills out. A judge issues this temporary injunction to protect someone from repeat violence under Florida Statute 784.046, usually before the full hearing and sometimes without advance notice to the respondent. It sets the date for that hearing, takes effect once the respondent is served, and states the protections ordered until the court decides whether to enter a final injunction. It explains that if either party fails to appear, they are still bound by whatever the court orders.
